reviews.title: Needs AUv3 support.
reviews.text:
Oh, look, biggest update ever! And still no AUv3 support. 

I won’t consider using it again until it has it. Do you understand how far you are behind the competition by not having this simple feature that even an independent, solo developer could easily implement into their very first app? It would be one thing if the included sounds and synths were just so good that you didn’t need anything else. But, they really, REALLY are not (to put it kindly). So, this will stay uninstalled until the problem (yes, problem) is fixed.

reviews.title: Scam app
reviews.text:
I can’t believe that a 10th Anniversary Edition only includes a sound pack to sell more sounds. It’s basically the previous version with a fresh coat of paint, still suffering from exactly the same performance issues. Performance is terrible, audio glitches and clips, and the app can’t even handle a project with just six tracks properly. It’s poorly optimized, missing countless features, and feels completely unfinished.

Now I understand why this app has a 3-star rating. What a disgrace. Zero shame in repackaging the same product with the same old problems and calling it an anniversary edition.

reviews.title: Magic Keyboard scrolling and AUv3
reviews.text:
In 2026, the app still doesn't support iPad Magic Keyboard gestures, such as swiping and scrolling.
I've been using the app for six years and I truly love it. However, the app critically lacks AUv3 support, which users have been asking for FOR YEARS. It also desperately needs more theme variety. There's no simple black and white design, and very little customization for ease of use. Nevertheless, the app isn't being abandoned, and I hope the developers will listen to their users one day.

reviews.title: A Beta Released as a Finished Product
reviews.text:
UPDATE 10/26: FIVE YEARS AGO THEY SAID AUv3 WAS COMING.
What kind of B.S. marketing strategy is this?

UPDATE: As of 3/21/20 IAA and AUv3 support is terrible, scanning causes crashes, many apps not seen by FLSM, those that load crash frequently, CPU overload for many third party apps, audio record workflow terrible. This dev obviously wants to keep users inside the FLSM sandbox and it is the reason this app is considered a toy in the iOS music market. With some modest effort this app could be a contender as it is it is a toy. ________________ 

It's not possible to record audio using IAA in FLM NOVEMBER 13, 2018! Here you see a prime example of upgrade insanity. A one time benchmark app made into a third rate bore. The developer misrepresented the feature set of this app and I fell for it. 

People lost countless hours of work and were stuck paying extra for nothing. Interconnectivity with other apps is hit and miss, the workflow is stilted. This is a good time for a competitor to claim this space. Right now BeatMaker 2 (yes 2) runs rings around this app. 
BeatMaker 3 is far superior, it accommodates voice and audio recording and IT SUPPORTS IAA! And this constant audio latency reset is unbelievably stupid.

reviews.title: Consistent Glitches / Lost Media
reviews.text:
I’ve had this app for about 5 years, hopping back on to tweak an old beat or trying something new. Every, single, time, I would open this app, there would be another glitch in my beats that needs updated. For example, the kicks won’t work because I have to reinstall the input, or a certain effect doesn’t work anymore. Now, after experiencing that same issue and attempting to troubleshoot it, I decided to delete the app and reinstall it to see if that would fix it. I’ve done it in the past and it worked out so no problem. Except this time, ALL OF MY FILES WERE DELETED.
Every, single beat I’ve made or worked on for the past 5 years is gone. Poof! Countless hours of effort to craft my own sounds, just for it to corrupt in a bad app and get lost somewhere. I tried recovering them, nothing works and they’ve vanished. Now I don’t even want to touch this app or the computer version. 

Overall, the experience was fun, but I would recommend investing your time in a different program that’s more stable than this one. Otherwise, everything you’ve worked on may be randomly deleted.

P.S. I purchased half of all the add ons, after my initial purchase of the app, and this happened.

Now, I have a new phone and I figured with newer software and more storage, I might be in luck! NOPE!!!
